add_box_to_planning_scene: add a box collision object to the MoveIt planning scene with specified dimensions and pose
add_cylinder_to_planning_scene: add a cylinder collision object to the planning scene with given height, radius, and pose
add_mesh_to_planning_scene: add a mesh collision object loaded from a file to the planning scene at a given pose
attach_box_to_robot_link: attach a box collision object to a specified robot link in the planning scene
remove_collision_object_from_scene: remove a named collision object from the MoveIt planning scene by its identifier
